summary: NervGen Pharma Corp. filed a Form 6-K disclosing that its audit committee, on September 25, 2026, concluded previously issued audited financial statements for fiscal years 2025 and 2024 and unaudited interim financials for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 should no longer be relied upon. Non-cash valuation errors in stock option and derivative warrant liability accounting overstated stock-based compensation and warrant liabilities. Restatement will come via amended Form 40-F and Form 6-K. Management and auditors KPMG Canada and KPMG US discussed the matter. Cash position and liquidity are unaffected. Watch for restatement completion and any regulatory or investor fallout.
